page.overview:
Who is Alexandra Giliani?

Alexandra Giliani is a Tilean physician and medical prodigy considered by some to be Shallya, the goddess of mercy and healing, reborn.

Alexandra Giliani was born and raised in Verezzo, Tilea, the daughter of an affluent merchant family, and, like her eight siblings, she attended university at a young age. Alexandra became fascinated by medicine, and by the age of 16 had already attained the finest medical education Tilea could offer. She then decided to travel abroad to learn the medical practices of other nations in the Old World.

Her journey began with the other Tilean city-states; she then moved through Estalia into Bretonnia via the port of L'Anguille, before arriving in Marienburg and finally traveling down the River Reik into the Empire to the city of Ubersreik by the age of 19.

Like a bloodhound, everywhere the young woman went, she sniffed out charlatans and false diagnoses, only to move on before any acclaim could be brought to her door. However, her recent stop may likely be her last. Giliani fell ill while investigating the strange plague in the Spittlefeld Tenement Building, right before it was boarded up. At the time, she was close to dying and perhaps the only person who knew the true cause of the illness -- though she hasn't the energy to tell anyone.
